entries.Original: Press the up and down buttons to scroll!
Search for aetherytes or zone names!

entries.Original: Search for game commands, like timers!

entries.Original: Run chat commands by typing them here!

entries.Original: Link macros to search in "wotsit settings"!

entries.Original: Search for names of gearsets, jobs or roles!
entries.Translated: 搜索套装、职业或职能名称！

entries.Original: Type mathematical expressions into the search bar!
entries.Translated: 在搜索栏中输入数学表达式！

entries.Original:
Use this menu to select the default search mode:
  - "Simple" looks for the exact text entered.
  - "Fuzzy" finds close matches to your text even if some characters are missing (e.g. "dufi" can locate the Duty Finder).
  - "FuzzyParts" is like Fuzzy but each word in the input is searched for separately, so that input word order does not matter.
entries.Translated:
使用此菜单选择默认搜索模式：
  - “简单”查找输入的精确文本。
  - “模糊”查找与文本接近的匹配项，即使缺少部分字符（例如“dufi”可找到任务搜索器）。
  - “模糊分词”类似模糊，但会分别搜索输入的每个词，因此输入词序无关紧要。

entries.Original: When using fuzzy search modes, results are shown in order from best match to worst match.
entries.Translated: 使用模糊搜索模式时，结果按匹配程度从高到低显示。

entries.Original: Inputting one of the prefixes below as the first character of your search text will temporarily change the search mode for that search.
entries.Translated: 在搜索文本首位输入以下任一前缀，可临时更改该次搜索的搜索模式。
模糊分词搜索模式前缀

entries.Original: When using the keyboard to scroll through results, customise the scroll delay and speed.
entries.Translated: 使用键盘滚动结果时，可自定义滚动延迟和速度。

entries.Original:
- The "System" scroll style matches the key repeat rate and delays from your operating system.
- The "Custom" scroll style lets you customize these settings for Wotsit.
entries.Translated:
- “系统”滚动样式与操作系统的按键重复率和延迟一致。
- “自定义”滚动样式可让你为 Wotsit 自定义这些设置。

entries.Original:
The number of milliseconds after to wait after pressing and holding Up/Down before the movement begins to repeat.

Control-click the slider to enter a custom value. Default: 120.
entries.Translated:
按住上/下键后，开始重复移动前等待的毫秒数。

按住 Ctrl 点击滑块可输入自定义值。默认：120。

entries.Original:
The number of milliseconds between each repeated line movement. Smaller numbers will repeat faster.

In the old system, "Slow" was 120, "Medium" was 65, and "Fast" was 30.

Control-click the slider to enter a custom value. Default: 65.
entries.Translated:
每次重复行移动之间的毫秒数。数值越小重复越快。

在旧系统中，“慢”为 120，“中”为 65，“快”为 30。

按住 Ctrl 点击滑块可输入自定义值。默认：65。

entries.Original:
The number of milliseconds after to wait after pressing and holding Pgp/PgD before the movement begins to repeat.

Control-click the slider to enter a custom value. Default: 200.
entries.Translated:
按住 Pgp/PgD 后，等待多少毫秒才开始重复移动。

按住 Ctrl 点击滑块可输入自定义值。默认：200。

entries.Original:
The number of milliseconds between each repeated page movement. Smaller numbers will repeat faster.

Control-click the slider to enter a custom value. Default: 200.
entries.Translated:
每次重复翻页之间的毫秒数。数值越小重复越快。

按住 Ctrl 点击滑块可输入自定义值。默认：200。

entries.Original:
Use this menu to tie constants to values, to be used in expressions.
Add a constant again to edit it.
entries.Translated:
使用此菜单将常量绑定到值，以便在表达式中使用。
再次添加常量即可编辑。

entries.Original: Searches via "Search text" (same as Wotsit search).
entries.Translated: 通过“搜索文本”进行搜索（与 Wotsit 搜索相同）。

entries.Original: Use this to change the order in which macro links are searched. This may affect which macro links are displayed higher in the result list.
entries.Translated: 用于更改宏链接的搜索顺序。这可能会影响结果列表中宏链接的显示顺序。

entries.Original:
Use this menu to tie search results to macros.
Click "Add Macro", enter the text you want to access it under, select whether or not it is a shared macro and enter its ID.
Use the ';' character to add search text for a macro, only the first part text will be shown, e.g. "SGE;sage;healer".
entries.Translated:
使用此菜单将搜索结果与宏关联。
点击“添加宏”，输入用于访问它的文本，选择是否为共享宏并输入其 ID。
使用“;”字符为宏添加搜索文本，仅显示第一部分文本，例如“SGE;sage;healer”。

entries.Original: Use arrows or drag and drop macros to change the order.
entries.Translated: 使用箭头或拖放宏来更改顺序。

entries.Original:
When using the default "Simple" search mode, results will appear in the order defined below.

For fuzzy search modes, results appear in 'best match' to 'worst match' order, and the order defined below will be used only for tie-breaks (when multiple results match equally well).

Un-ticking a check box will cause all entries from that category to be ignored in any mode.
entries.Translated:
使用默认的“简单”搜索模式时，结果将按下方定义的顺序显示。

对于模糊搜索模式，结果按“最佳匹配”到“最差匹配”的顺序显示，下方定义的顺序仅用于打破平局（当多个结果匹配程度相同时）。

取消勾选某个复选框将导致该类别中的所有条目在任何模式下都被忽略。

entries.Original:
The weight setting for each category can be used to adjust the internal match score calculated for results when using fuzzy search modes. When compared to the default weight of 100, for example, a category with a weight of 200 will have its match scores doubled while a category with a weight of 50 will have them halved.

Search results with higher weightings tend to have higher match scores, and therefore appear higher in the results list.

Weights are ignored when using the "Simple" search mode.
entries.Translated:
每个类别的权重设置可用于调整模糊搜索模式下为结果计算的内部匹配分数。例如，与默认权重 100 相比，权重为 200 的类别其匹配分数将翻倍，而权重为 50 的类别其匹配分数将减半。

权重较高的搜索结果往往具有较高的匹配分数，因此在结果列表中显示得更靠前。

使用“简单”搜索模式时忽略权重。
